messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Metering anomaly detected — token-count drift on /proxy-ingest (apac). +18% token delta vs rolling baseline; several overage flags triggered. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/metering-drift. Paging sre_oncall_lee.

sre_oncall_lee: Ack. Joining thread. Pulling metrics now.

ops_alex: seeing consumer lag on apac-emitter-kafka > 80k, reconnect churn after deploy ~00:12 UTC. Might be replay + delayed emits.

sre_oncall_lee: quick query: `SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM metered_events WHERE region='apac' AND window=now()-1h GROUP BY emitter` — emitter 'proxy-main' shows 1.8x expected in 10m bucket.

billing_maria: We're getting auto overage notifications for accounts: C-1132, C-2290, C-3309. UI flags + email triggers already fired. Can we confirm duplicates vs late windows?

sre_oncall_lee: suspect duplicate replays from emitter after consumer rollback. I'm suspending emitter replay and toggling idempotency guard.

billing-bot: Billing pipeline note: 38 invoices queued that may include anomalous tokens (flagged). Suggested action: hold invoice job.

support_jamie: Customers pinging support about unexpected overage emails. Which customers are impacted beyond Maria's list? Need prioritized list for account teams.

billing_maria: additional impacted: C-4451, C-5002 (low-dollar), and 5 enterprise tenants where alerts escalated. I'll assemble list and tag AMs.

sre_lead_tom: TL;DR mitigation plan: 1) pause billing writes to ledger; 2) enable shadow-only pipeline for current window; 3) run de-dup scrub job; 4) prepare manual credits for impacted accounts. Lee, can you drive 1-3 right now?

sre_oncall_lee: On it. Running:
```
# pause billing writer
kubectl -n metering scale deployment billing-writer --replicas=0
# set emitter to shadow
curl -XPOST https://ops-api/emitter/proxy-main/toggle -d '{"mode":"shadow"}'
# kick scrub
python tools/scrub_duplicates.py --region apac --since 2026-03-18T00:00:00Z --dryrun=false
```
I'll post outputs in 2–3m. ETA scrub ~12m.

ops_alex: applied emitter throttles and backoff. consumer lag dropping from 82k -> 6k in last 7m.

billing_maria: Holding today's invoice job and suppressing auto-alerts. Opening internal billing incident INC-6621 to track credits.

support_jamie: Drafting customer note: short: "We've detected transient billing noise affecting a subset of customers. We're pausing billing and will apply corrections — no action required from you." Will share for approval.

sre_oncall_lee: Scrub job log snippet: `duplicate_candidates=279412, distinct=45_accounts, potential_overcount_tokens=282k` — looks like duplicates concentrated to 3 emitter partitions.

sre_lead_tom: Good catch. Maria — rough scope (tokens & accounts) looks manageable for manual credits. Suggest communicate ETA for remediation ~2 hours, immediate temporary credits applied same-day.

billing_maria: Agreed. I'll allocate provisional credits equal to duplicated token cost and block auto-invoicing for today. Updating INC-6621 with amounts.

incident-bot: Handoff scheduled: day-oncall @sre_oncall_anna at 1769800600 — please confirm receipt.

sre_oncall_anna: Taking handoff now. @sre_oncall_lee please paste final state and any followups.

sre_oncall_lee: Summary for handoff -> Cause: emitter replay after consumer restart produced duplicate emits for proxy-main (apac). Impact: ~280k duplicated tokens across 45 accounts; 38 invoice jobs flagged; several customers received overage alerts. Mitigation done: paused billing-writer, emitter set to shadow, throttles applied, scrub job running (50% complete), manual credit plan created. Next steps: finish scrub, validate ledger diffs, apply credits, unblock invoice job after validation.

sre_oncall_anna: Acknowledged. I'll monitor scrub -> ledger diff -> billing corrections. If scrub uncovers more partitions, escalate to Tom.

support_jamie: Notified AMs for top 10 impacted customers, told them we will follow up with corrected statements.

billing-bot: Audit note: manual credits queued: 45 accounts, draft memos attached to INC-6621.

sre_oncall_lee: Leaving on-call handoff notes in OpsDoc: https://redwood/ops/hand-offs/1769800000-metering-drift.

sre_oncall_anna: Thanks all, keeping this open until invoice job unblocked and credits applied. Ping here with final ledger checksum. :white_check_mark:
